skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Kabuto Rage: Deals damage to a single target with 5 consecutive strikes for 100% ATK plus 25% of Max HP as extra DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Chaos Dancer: Deals 400% ATK DMG to a single target and grants [Charge DMG] equal to 35% of Max HP. After release, gains [Wild] this round and performs [Ultimate Follow-up] when an enemy takes action. [Ultimate Follow-up]: deals 100% of the DMG and effect of the Ultimate skill, no Follow-up cost, up to 2 times per round. Heals self up to 35% of Max HP within 1 round.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Chaos Dancer (upgraded): Deals 400% ATK DMG to a single target and grants [Charge DMG] equal to 35% > 45% of Max HP. After release, gains [Wild] this round and performs [Ultimate Follow-up] when an enemy takes action. [Ultimate Follow-up]: deals 100% of the DMG and effect of the Ultimate skill, no Follow-up cost, up to 2 times per round. Heals self up to 35% of Max HP within 1 round.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Highly Evolved: Upon taking damage (even through shields) or being defeated, reflects 50% of DMG received onto 4 random enemies. Damage includes all Tenacity effects and HP-consumption effects. Only one effect of the same type per battle. Permanently increases HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Highly Evolved (upgraded): Upon taking damage (even through shields) or being defeated, reflects 50% > 60% of DMG received onto 4 random enemies. Damage includes all Tenacity effects and HP-consumption effects. Only one effect of the same type per battle. Permanently increases HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Highly Evolved (5P): Upon taking damage (even through shields) or being defeated, reflects 60% of DMG received onto all enemies (upgraded from 4 random enemies). Damage includes all Tenacity effects and HP-consumption effects. Only one effect of the same type per battle. Permanently increases HP.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Heavily Armored: When battle begins, increases Max HP by 25%, quadruples the Max HP boost effect on himself (same as the Gyoro core, not stackable with WDM HP boost), and recovers 50% of Max HP.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Max HP boost 25% > 30%. After being defeated, revives with 70% HP the next round (once per battle).

effects.desc: Out of turn attacks deal 70% of the ultimate's damage and effects, without consuming mana, up to 3 times per round.
